data.name: Delta Poly: Block Ops
data.detailed_description:
Delta Poly: Block Ops is a low-poly, large-scale tactical FPS built for epic, extended battles. Join up to 64 players on massive maps in conquest-style warfare, where vehicles, class roles, and territorial control define the fight.

Engage across desert, urban, and varied terrain as you command jets, tanks, helicopters, Humvees, motorbikes, AA guns, missile trucks, and more. Capture strategic points, hold supply lines, defend bases, or push deep into enemy territory. Each map is alive with mounted weapons, anti-aircraft emplacements, and vehicular chokepoints.

Choose from multiple classes—Marine, Sniper, Special Ops, Engineer, and more—each offering unique gear, load-outs, and tactical roles. Unlock new weapons, vehicle upgrades, and cosmetic customizations that let you shape your battlefield identity.

We plan to span multiple eras / timelines (World War II, modern, and possibly future or WWI) across different maps and gear sets, giving each match its own flavor.

Whether you're piloting a jet, repairing a tank under fire, or flanking with your squad, Delta Poly: Block Ops aims to combine deep warfare systems with stylized, low-poly visuals for something fresh, massive, and full of strategic depth.

content_descriptors.notes:
Delta Poly: Block Ops is a stylized, low-poly first-person shooter that depicts modern military combat. While the art style is blocky and non-realistic, the game includes the following mature content:

Violence: Gunplay, explosions, and combat between opposing forces. Characters fall when defeated, vehicles and buildings can be destroyed. There is no gore, dismemberment, or realistic blood effects.

Warfare Themes: The game features factions inspired by modern military and insurgent forces, which may touch on sensitive real-world conflicts.

Language: Some voice lines may contain mild military-themed profanity or aggressive phrases.

The game does not include depictions of sexual acts, sexual assault, drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm.
